title: Naming Conventions
description: Use camelCase for variables and functions, PascalCase for classes, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants.

title: Error Handling
description: Always handle errors explicitly. Never swallow exceptions silently. Use typed error classes for domain errors.

title: Repository Pattern
description: Data access must go through repository interfaces. No direct DB queries in services or controllers.

title: Dependency Injection
description: Classes receive their dependencies via constructor. No static singletons. Use a DI container for wiring.

title: Single Responsibility
description: Each module, class, and function should have exactly one reason to change. Split when a unit handles multiple concerns.
